Dear [Mrs Mercier](/person/990),
I enclose a cheque for the remainder of Campanella and send at the same time a proof of Mr Peabody, hoping you will not sacrifice the modest request which seems to me too good to be lost.
Thank you for [Miss Tucker’](/person/1424)s address I hope she has heard from [Mr Warne](/person/1433) by this time[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Lady Betty is an admirable story


[^2]: Miss Tucker may perhaps have been author of one of the [Victoria Tales and Stories](/book/211) series edited by CMY and published by Warne.
